Lemma
Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0074, chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0075 1. Lemma 2.46\group neckpinch

If the limiting growth parameter $\rho (T)$ is finite, then the comparison function $v=\psi _s$ dominates the linear subsolution $\underline v$ on the interior region up to time $T$.
